campus: University Campus, Via G. Amendola 165/A, 70126 Bari
academic_requirements: A bachelor's degree or an equivalent foreign qualification recognized by the programme board/appointed committee.
At least 24 CFU/ECTS in the specified scientific-disciplinary sectors.
Personal preparation must be assessed positively; a bachelor's final grade above 89/110 (or equivalent) gives a positive outcome, while other applicants take the stated multiple-choice assessment.
qualification_system_requirements: A foreign qualification must be recognized as equivalent to a bachelor's degree.
The DreamApply overview describes the foreign qualification as equal to a three-year, full-time undergraduate qualification of 180 ECTS.

required_subject_credits.ssd_or_domain: MAT/01-MAT/09; FIS/01-FIS/03, FIS/06-FIS/07; CHIM/01-CHIM/12; GEO/02-GEO/07, GEO/11-GEO/12; BIO/01-BIO/19; AGR/01-AGR/20; ING-IND/09-ING-IND/17, ING-IND/22-ING-IND/27, ING-IND/29, ING-IND/34-ING-IND/35; ING-INF/01-ING-INF/07; SECS-S/01-SECS-S/06; SECS-P/05-SECS-P/08; SECS-P/10
required_subject_credits.notes: Applicants lacking these credits may acquire them through individual UNIBA courses before admission.

language_requirements: Non-native English speakers without an English-medium prior qualification must demonstrate CEFR B2 English.
Applicants who are not native Italian speakers must also demonstrate CEFR B2 Italian at access.
language_level: B2 English and, for non-native Italian speakers, B2 Italian
accepted_language_evidence: Programme language test: 20 grammar/reading-comprehension questions, passed with at least 11 correct answers
personal_preparation_assessment: A programme teaching committee reviews the applicant. A bachelor's final grade above 89/110 or equivalent is automatically considered positive. Otherwise the applicant takes a 30-question multiple-choice assessment on low-input/low-impact agri-food techniques, waste reduction and biomass reuse/valorization, and enterprise development/cross-cutting skills; 18 correct answers are required.
ofa_or_remedial_obligations: Applicants missing the 24-CFU curricular requirement may acquire the missing credits by enrolling in individual courses offered by UNIBA before admission.

entry_exam_or_test.name: IDEAS personal-preparation multiple-choice questionnaire
entry_exam_or_test.language: [uncertain] Not explicitly stated; programme teaching is English
subjects: Innovative techniques to reduce inputs and impacts in agri-food systems
Innovative techniques to reduce waste and reuse/valorize biomass
entry_exam_or_test.notes: Required when the bachelor's final grade is 89/110 or lower (or equivalent). Separate language tests have 20 questions and require 11 correct answers unless exempt by certificate/status.

selection_score_and_ranking: No competitive ranking is stated for the open-access programme. Personal preparation is positive above 89/110 (or equivalent), or with at least 18/30 correct answers on the questionnaire; each required language test is passed with at least 11/20.
